name: ENISA CSIRT Network
description: Connects Computer Security Incident Response Teams across EU member states with formal peer review programs and maturity assessments.

peerReview.processDescription: CSIRTs undergo peer reviews by teams from other EU member states. Assessed against SIM3 maturity model. Cross-border coordination. EU-CyCLONe for operational cooperation.

attribution.attributionNotes: Formal assessment of incident response capabilities. ENISA certification recognized across EU.

povsAlignment.description: Internal audit success through cross-border CSIRT peer review and maturity assessment.
